headline: Track projects, invoices, and revisions with ease
value_proposition: A bilingual (Arabic and English) digital template pack built for local freelancing habits, with no subscriptions and no client data collection.
features: Track client projects, invoices, and revision rounds using Notion and Google Sheets
Bilingual support for Arabic and English to work with local and international clients
No subscriptions, no client data collection, and no user accounts
Simple templates for easy use without complex setup
Helps manage multiple clients without stress

faq.q: What is included in the template pack?
faq.a: The template pack includes Notion and Google Sheets templates for tracking client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.

faq.q: Can I use the templates in Arabic and English?
faq.a: Yes, the templates are bilingual and support both Arabic and English for seamless use with local and international clients.

faq.q: Does the product collect client data?
faq.a: No, the product does not collect any client data. It is designed to help you manage your projects without storing sensitive information.
No, there are no subscriptions. The template pack is a one-time purchase with no recurring fees.

faq.q: What file formats are the templates available in?
faq.a: The templates are available in Notion and Google Sheets formats for easy access and use.
